check-solution:read.title: Solution check: a binomial probability
check-solution:read.problem: A fair coin is tossed 5 times. What is the probability of exactly 2 heads?

steps.comment: Correct definition of the variable and its distribution.
The factor for the three failures is missing: $\left(\tfrac12\right)^{3}$.

hints: Look at the binomial formula: how many factors does it have, and what does each one stand for?
Besides the successes, you also need the probability of the three failures.

comments.comment: The arithmetic here is also wrong: $\tfrac{10}{4}=2.5$, not $2.4$. And a probability can't be greater than 1, which is a sign that something went wrong earlier. (demo mode)
